correlates.name: Emphysema-predominant COPD
correlates.presentation: A 64-year-old woman with 50 pack-years has 3 years of progressive exertional dyspnea, little cough or sputum and 8-kg weight loss. Thin, breathes out slowly through pursed lips, uses neck muscles; quiet breath sounds, prolonged expiration. SpO2 93%; PaCO2 38 mmHg.
correlates.workup: Post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC 0.52, FEV1 45% predicted, TLC 125%, RV 180%, DLCO 40%. Film: flattened diaphragms, widened rib spaces, hyperlucent lungs, long narrow heart; CT: upper-lobe loss of tissue around the central acinus.
correlates.management: Stop smoking; one long-acting bronchodilator (LABA or LAMA), or LABA plus LAMA if symptoms are high or exacerbations frequent; SABA or SAMA for rescue; long-term oxygen if hypoxemic, the only step proven to improve survival.

correlates.name: Chronic bronchitis
correlates.presentation: A 58-year-old man with 45 pack-years has coughed up sputum on most days for 4-5 months of every year for the past 3 years, with exertional dyspnea. BMI 33, cyanotic lips, scattered wheezes and coarse crackles, ankle edema. SpO2 87%; hematocrit 56%.
correlates.workup: Post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC 0.60, FEV1 55% predicted, no meaningful bronchodilator response. Airway biopsy: enlarged, multiplied submucosal mucous glands filling more than half the wall between epithelium and cartilage.

correlates.name: Bronchiectasis
correlates.presentation: A 41-year-old woman with sinus infections since childhood and a heart on the right side on an old film has coughed up a cupful of thick yellow-green sputum daily for 3 years, with repeated chest infections and two bouts of blood-streaked sputum. Clubbing; coarse basal crackles.
correlates.workup: CT: lower-lobe and lingular bronchi wider than their companion arteries that fail to taper toward the periphery, with thickened walls and mucus plugging; spirometry: FEV1/FVC 0.66.
correlates.management: For a flare: send a new sputum culture and start empiric antibiotics tailored to the most recent culture, plus airway clearance, a mucoactive agent and oxygen; long-term goal of 2 or fewer exacerbations a year.
